pitfalls.name: Inverse relationships not explicitly declared
pitfalls.description: This pitfall appears when any relationship (except for those that are defined as symmetric properties using owl:SymmetricProperty) does not have an inverse relationship (owl:inverseOf) defined within the ontology.

iterations.fix_applied: Add owl:inverseOf for each object property where logical inverse exists.

pitfalls.name: Misusing ontology annotations
pitfalls.description: The contents of some annotation properties are swapped or misused. This pitfall might affect annotation properties related to natural language information (for example, annotations for naming such as rdfs:label or for providing descriptions such as rdfs:comment). Other types of annotation could also be affected as temporal, versioning information, among others.

iterations.fix_applied: Review and correct rdfs:label and rdfs:comment for affected inverse properties to ensure labels and comments are not swapped or misused.
